items.title: On a curve over an algebraically closed field torsion cohomology vanishes in degrees at least three, and in degree two when the curve is affine
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The theorem establishes the vanishing of torsion cohomology above degree two on a curve over an algebraically closed field, and above degree one when the curve is affine (statement lines 15739-15748). The proof (proof lines 15750-15766) quotes the precise vanishing theorem for the separated case and, in general, inducts over an affine open covering using Mayer-Vietoris together with the vanishing on the affine intersection. H2: one induction with a spectral input, written out.
